ops.title: install-desk-5 handoff Nov 7 12:45 AM
ops.body:
install-desk-5 handoff, Nov 7 12:45 AM PT. Mac lane, standing install desk for drive durable-agents-rebuild.

## State on the Mac (read)
- Pack 0.7.1963. lr 0.1233.1. Supervisor pid 40358 at generation 721 serves pack 0.7.1963. Carries cc-skills through 215a3b3 (#3793).
- cc-present 0.58.1, cc-slack 0.15.4 (carries cc-slack#176, check-post fix; proof: `echo hi | BINRUN_PLUGIN_ROOT=<long-running pack dir> cc-slack check-post -` exits 0). cci 0.54.3.
- ~/Code/monorepo/mise.local.toml `[wrappers.go]` now points at /Users/yasyf/Code/monorepo/tools/remote-builder/shims/rb-go. It used to point at a deleted worktree. Backup: ~/.vcache/scratch/install-desk-5/mise.local.toml.bak.

## Open asks (meta-desk-4 unless named)
1. 401618@00624701: the Sprites are stale. pool-mkjizircrzsea54o and owed-takeover-6 still serve 0.7.1928. Roll every live Sprite to 0.7.1963+ and post each Sprite's version. Lead, inferred and not checked: every lr install tonight printed only `lr sprites roll: could not reach dar-desk-3 ... never reached: dar-desk-3` and then 'the desk host did not move'. The roll most likely stops at the desk host when dar-desk-3 is down (Storage not ready), so no worker Sprite rolled after 0.7.1928. Read `lr sprites` and the roll code path. If the desk host's failure stops the roll, that is the defect: name it to meta-desk with a fix lane, and roll the workers.
2. 401939@00624701: install long-running at main 78a15ed+ (#3797). Also cc-inbox at main b603107+ (#515, carries #514). This supersedes 401118 (417e9e4).
3. 401394@00624701: ccx (cc-context) at main b220ef1+ (#868) on the Mac and the Sprites.
4. A background script of mine may still be running: ~/.vcache/scratch/install-desk-5/cci-at.zsh 417e9e4. It waits for cc-inbox CI, then runs cci upgrade/serve, the plugin update and lr sprites pin. Its target is now b603107, so re-run it with b603107 and that commit's CI run id.

## Scripts
- ~/.vcache/scratch/install-desk-5/install-at.zsh <commit> <CI run id> <lr release run id>: waits for both runs, finds the newest long-running tag carrying the commit, waits for CI on that tag's base, then runs lr install.
- `lr install` refuses while CI on the tag's base is red or running. Never pass --ci-red-ok without meta-desk's reason.

## Lessons
- cci show the record before `--resolves`. I closed 578337 by mistake, which was the wrong seq (corrected in 578922). cc-inbox#514 makes --resolves echo the record it closes.
- 0.7.1951 stalled 15 minutes because gc passes held the in-place serve. #3779 fixed it (log in supervisor-1951-window.log).
- Mac landing and bk-desk died at 6:32 PM with root's terminal (576835). Per meta-desk 394416, landing-desk restarts them as launchd jobs.
